تستنطقون (form X)
# تَسْتَنْطِقُونَ (tastanṭiqūna) /tas.tan.tˤi.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# تُسْتَنْطَقُونَ (tustanṭaqūna) /tus.tan.tˤa.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
